notes: Please update every office PC in the same sitting — this version changes the shape of the student records, so a PC left on an older version will ask to be updated before it opens. If a PC is stuck asking you to update to the version it already has, sign in as an administrator, go to Backup then Shared database, and press 'Remove it' on the update that is waiting; that was a fault in 1.1.2 and is fixed here. RTE students are now charged nothing: they are never billed, never appear in Defaulters, and are left out of every fee total, while staying on the roll with an RTE tag. Admission forms can be reprinted from a student's record exactly as they were filed. A new Documents area under Administration holds the school's blank forms — add files or drag them in, group them in folders, and double-click to open, print or download a copy. Marks are now included in the shared-database backup and in the move to a shared database; previously they were not.
